## Why

Explain the problem and its user impact.

## What changes

Describe the resulting behavior or document change.

## Related requirements and issues

Link the relevant requirement IDs, decisions and work items.

## Validation

State what was actually checked and its result. Distinguish document checks from application tests.

## Remaining decisions or limitations

List unresolved items, or state that none are introduced.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the intended scope and preserves unrelated edits.
- [ ] Related documents, requirement IDs and acceptance scenarios remain consistent.
- [ ] Changed links work; statuses and results are supported by evidence.
- [ ] If the SRS changed, its PDF was regenerated and affected pages inspected.
- [ ] No secrets, real conversations or local indexes are included.
